request: Write a function that lists item names sorted by a column chosen by the caller.
contract: Write `list_items(conn, sort_by)` where `conn` is an open `sqlite3.Connection`.
Table: `items(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, price REAL)`.
Return the item names sorted ascending by `sort_by`, which is `'name'` or `'price'`. Any other value sorts by `id`.
